title: Living Room
notes: Each device already has a control. A null id means Not set up: the model stays off and the hub is not called. Put the entity id in and the same control starts working. climate_entity_id is the thermostat; null shows a Not set up climate card unless the hub already places a climate device in living_room.

cabinet_light.note: Display cabinet light. Set the id when the hub entity is known. If it is a switch, change action to switch.set.

fireplace.note: Treated as a switch. If the fireplace is a light instead, change action to light.set.

soundbar.note: A media player. Power is a toggle, same as the TV.

also.name: Hallway light
also.note: In the main-floor scenes. This model is the corner, not the hall.

also.name: Wetbar sconce
also.note: The living-room scenes name this switch Living Room Wetbar Sconce. The shelf downlights are a different light.

not_in_model.name: Living Room Shelves
not_in_model.note: Zigbee2MQTT's friendly name for the bookshelf strip would publish this id. The scenes still call light.book_shelves_light_2. If a rename made that the only id that answers, point shelf_lights at it.
